summary: Informal dirt car area by the rail corridor with cars already parked.
reasons: Backs onto rail corridor, cars park here
Dirt surface meets the street edge

best_section.where: Dirt and gravel pull-in at the end of the street beside the rail line, just north-west of the pin

drivers.seclusion: Rail tracks on one side and trees and grass on the other; nearest building is a hotel 17 m away (non-residential), nearest dwellings 44 m and further.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt surface meets the sealed street directly and several cars stand on it; room for a van beside them.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial road about 40 m to the east and trains alongside; the van stands clear of both lanes.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked on the dirt in both images, so a parked vehicle does not stand out.

flags: Noise: rail line beside it and a busy arterial nearby
Low-lying: about 8-9 m elevation, Brisbane River 276 m away
Pin on a corner: exact boundary of the dirt area against the rail fence is unclear
Hotel 17 m away may have evening activity
sun_shade: Tree cover over the western edge and shade from trees to the north-west; open to the sun from the east and south.
cannot_judge: Whether the dirt area is signed or fenced off
